Emailing your results

Please take a clear picture of the whole card and email it to results@lincolnpool.co.uk.

Please include which league and the result in the subject line.

Example: Thurs 1, "Home Team Name" 7 "Away Team Name" 3

If the match is a draw the home team is responsible for submitting the result card.

If you do not include fixture details and the result on the subject line your result may not be accepted.

Knockout results

Knockout results and claims can be emailed to kosecretary@lincolnpool.co.uk or sent by text or WhatsApp to 07765 662647.

Download or view the Knockout Rounds here

If no result by text, WhatsApp or email is received by the closing date players will be eliminated, no excuses, no exceptions.

Match Secretary

Sean Goucher is the Match Secretary. Telephone/WhatsApp 07305 745460 or matchsecretary@lincolnpool.co.uk.
